images.observation: Light home: centered input, independent Nook identity, model setup entry and sidebar actions remain visible.
Light conversation: reply, GFM table, message actions, usage text and composer are legible.
Dark settings: neutral modal, selected section, labeled controls and close action remain visible; the longer form scrolls within the modal.
Light project: file tree, active editor tab, path, save action and local syntax rendering are legible.
Narrow dark project: active tab, unsaved marker, compact save action and editor remain visible; long tree names are abbreviated.
Narrow approval: before/after content, scrolling original text, reject, allow and stop actions remain visible.
Narrow malformed diagram: original source is retained with horizontal scrolling and a Chinese recovery message.
Light rich reply: inline/display math and JavaScript/PowerShell code surfaces render with local fonts and restrained syntax colors.
Narrow dark rich reply: math and text remain legible; the transcript scrolls behind the fixed composer rather than fitting all content simultaneously.
Minimum-window terminal: terminal tab, close/new controls, command prompt, editor tab and unsaved marker remain visible.

scope: Ten complete-run originals individually inspected in addition to the separately counted tool-activity originals. These static observations do not prove every page, all reference states, real system DPI, physical input or assistive-technology behavior.
